description.en: The instance ID of the current Spark instance.

description.zh:
仅对bds查询关联hbase有效。

- true：会包含单节点HBase。

- false：不包含单节点HBase。非必填，为兼容之前逻辑为空时会包含单节点HBase。
description.en:
This parameter is valid only when bds queries associated HBase instances.

- true: Single-node HBase instances are included.

- false: Single-node HBase instances are not included. This parameter is optional. For backward compatibility, single-node HBase instances are included when this parameter is left empty.

description.zh:
要查询可关联数据库类型。

- spark可以关联hdfs,hbase,mongodb,mysql,polardb_mysql,redis,geomesa
- bds可以关联hbase,spark,hbaseue
description.en:
The type of database to query for association.

- spark can be associated with hdfs, hbase, mongodb, mysql, polardb_mysql, redis, and geomesa.
- bds can be associated with hbase, spark, and hbaseue.

title.zh: 查询当前实例可关联的数据库列表
title.en: Query databases that can be associated with the current instance

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbase query-xpack-relate-db --cluster-id ap-bp1qtz9rcbbt3p6ng --relate-db-type hbase --has-single-node false --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun hbase QueryXpackRelateDB --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterId 'ap-bp1qtz9rcbbt3p6ng' --HasSingleNode false --RelateDbType hbase
